blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ABS-CBN Corp. announced on Wednesday that it will continue to be led by the Lopez family, even with the introduction of a new investor as part of a P6-billion investment plan. Stockholders approved the new investments and the issuance of additional shares during a meeting on Sept. 30. READ: ABS-CBN sets stage for P6-billion infusion The capital will come from Crème Investment Corp., Mantes Corp. and Presta Holding Company Inc., which represent three branches of the Lopez family.
